concepts.definition: A product manufactured by a third party and sold under the retailer's own brand.
The smallest number of units a factory accepts per order.

questions.q: Compare the upfront cost and risk of private label and dropshipping.
questions.a: Private label needs design, samples and a minimum order in advance, so cost and risk are higher; dropshipping buys nothing before a sale.

questions.q: What makes a pre-sale test of a private label product honest?
questions.a: Labeling it clearly as a pre-order with a realistic delivery date and offering a delay or refund choice if the date slips.
